stations.title: Gethin
stations.say: Why is it silent after three?

stations.title: Playlist script
stations.text: Asks once, and gives up on any bad status.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Answers 503 for a few seconds, then 200.

captions: Gethin wants to know why the station goes silent after the nightly restart.
The playlist script gets one 503 and gives up, the same as for a missing show.
You sort statuses into families and decide what each one means, in three tasks.
The script asks again after the 503, gets the playlist, and the music plays.
The family of a status says what to do. Ask again only when the server is in trouble.
